Overview

Cairo is a city in Cairo with a population of 9,500,000. Egypt’s sprawling capital and largest city in the Arab world, home to the Pyramids, ancient history, and a vibrant modern culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
